pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::pdf_page_count;

fn main() {
    let pdf_bytes = std::fs::read(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../../test_documents/pdf/sample_contract.pdf")).expect("test_documents/pdf/sample_contract.pdf must exist");
    let password: Option<String> = None;
    let result = pdf_page_count(&pdf_bytes, password.as_deref());
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
